change: Spring Batch #495 second commit, persisted checkpoint selection and restarted reads
deployment: Pinned SimpleJobRepository over Spring Batch 3.0.7, its original JDBC DAOs, HSQLDB 2.3.2 and default context serializer on JDK 8.
assumptions: Fresh working directory and file database per JVM. Step 1 saves offset 2 and step 2 saves offset 5. The two job executions share one job instance. The first opens the seven-line file anew for each saved context.

questions.observer: Report selected step ID, restored marker, saved offset and the next two actual FlatFileItemReader records, including after HSQLDB shutdown and reopen.
questions.basis: The parent takes the last encountered tie. The fix takes the larger ID. The original JDBC DAO orders job executions by descending ID.

questions.observer: Observe the same identifiers and restarted rows for forward ties, a later first execution and an unknown step.
questions.basis: The larger ID is last in forward order. A later time outranks either ID. An unknown name has no saved context.
